brief_summary: The study plans to compare the glucose-lowering effect of gurmar, a herbal preparation, with metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes
brief_title: Double Blind Randomized Trial to Compare Gurmar (Gymnema Sylvestre) With Metformin in Type 2 Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Newly detected type 2 diabetes
* Fasting plasma glucose \>126mg/dl
* HbA1c \> 7%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Serious comorbid illnesss
* History of drug abuse
* History of recent weight loss

lead_sponsor.name: Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh
